summary: 40 units reviewed. Issue counts: error 3, minor 59, 55 machine patches. Errors: unit 22 (dūṣī-viṣa must follow glossary 14.4 tainting poison), unit 29 (masculine participles cannot agree with feminine śālmalī; Hindi/English also disagree on mūla-vatsa-nābha). Main minor classes: unmarked additions (unit 26 'thus', unit 32 '[likewise]'/'वह भी', unit 27 योग for upanayana), identification of obscure names (units 4, 7, 10, 13, 15, 27 notes and Hindi), invented split (units 19, 30), eka-patnī (unit 36), Hindi brackets (unit 4), mleccha (unit 2), grouping (unit 3). Flags: confirmed as typos: upabbhogeṣu, diṇga, mastya, madna, 'it', bhavti, ballātaka, nispratīkāro, namāste; accepted only as 'possible': pūki.kīṭa (weak, pūti-kīṭa recurs in the same sentence), avalgu.jara (avalguja is a real drug name), citram, kanda(kardama?) (editor's doubt mark, not a typo), mūka.badhira..karo (better suggestion mūka.badhirī.karo). Not flagged by the drafter but should be: samyuktaṃ/samyogaḥ (units 4, 5, 29), kārpāsa.- (11), niṣpratikāro (38), eka.antra (21). No regrouping of any unit. dhanus settled as 'dhanus' (glossary appended). Confidence: unit 5 lowered to low; others honest. No patch touches a token or src.
